title: Quick check: Writing Custom Hooks

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes the purpose of “Writing Custom Hooks”?
options: The browser will infer all application behavior even if inputs and state are contradictory.
The concept allows application code to mutate React-managed DOM and state directly.
Extracting shared logic should follow Hook rules and be used only where its specific behavior is needed.
The concept removes the need to consider error states or accessibility.
questions.answer_key: Extracting shared logic should follow Hook rules and be used only where its specific behavior is needed.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in Writing Custom Hooks: Extracting shared logic should follow Hook rules and be used only where its specific behavior is needed.

questions.prompt: Which practice is most reliable when applying Extracting shared logic?
options: Optimize by adding every available Hook without measuring the result.
Call Hooks at the top level of React components or custom Hooks, never conditionally.
Skip validation because a successful render proves that the application is correct.
Store duplicate copies of every value so each component can change it independently.
questions.answer_key: Call Hooks at the top level of React components or custom Hooks, never conditionally.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in Writing Custom Hooks: Call Hooks at the top level of React components or custom Hooks, never conditionally.

questions.prompt: What should you verify before considering “Writing Custom Hooks” complete?
options: Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
Check only whether the file exists; syntax and runtime behavior do not matter.
Assume a client-side check proves that a remote service accepted the change.
Rely only on a screenshot of the happy path and never repeat the test.
questions.answer_key: Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in Writing Custom Hooks: Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
